_readme: WHERE A COMMAND LINE KEEPS THE THINGS PEOPLE ADD TO IT: skills, agents,
commands, rules, plugins. This file is the only place in the inventory that
names a product. The code reads it and knows nothing else.
IT EXISTS BECAUSE THE CRATE USED TO NAME ONE. `crates/inventory` had
`.claude/...` built into every path it looked at, so on a machine holding a
different command line it answered «you have nothing» without failing a
single check — the worst shape a wrong answer can take. The rule it broke is
the standing one: a product's name may appear in a label, never in a
condition, and a constructed path is a condition.
TO ADD ONE: put a `.json` file with this shape in
`~/.config/sailor/extensions.d/`. An `id` already here is replaced by yours.
Nothing needs recompiling, and nothing in the code has to learn the name.
WHAT THE INVENTORY SAYS ABOUT WHAT IS NOT HERE. A product nobody declared is
not searched, and the survey says so by name-count rather than staying
silent: «looked at 1 of the command lines declared here» is a true sentence,
